gaps: No complete company-reported phase-count series was verified; counts is null rather than a manual tally.
Origin was not verified for TAK-881, mezagitamab and TAK-360; these origins are null. TAK-360 has no separate verified generic name or alternative code.

Dated next milestones were not verified for most selected assets. TAK-928 has an announced Phase 3 study expansion without a stated date. Arcotatug's Japan filing is explicitly FY2027 (April 2027–March 2028), so next.when is null to avoid mislabeling it as calendar 2027.

Already approved uses, regional-only filings of approved indications (including rusfertide in the EU), and unexercised option assets were excluded. TAK-881 is a new investigational formulation; vedolizumab's filed pediatric expansion was not selected within the eight-asset shortlist.
The FY2025 SEC filing predates 2026-06 and is used only for the historical Nimbus/zasocitinib acquisition, not current development status.
Protein replacement and ligand-trap modalities are mapped to other because the allowed vocabulary has no recombinant/plasma protein category.
